verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill pack installed through a plugin marketplace, so release notes or a changelog are a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence covers installation, the skills' capabilities and helper scripts, but never mentions releases, version tags, release notes or a changelog. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
